articles.title: US ambassador says South Africa’s AGOA removal preventable Staff Reporter US Ambassador to South Africa has described the country’s removal from the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) trade preference programme as “predictable and preventa - Instagram
articles.summary: US ambassador says South Africa’s AGOA removal preventable Staff Reporter US Ambassador to South Africa has described the country’s removal from the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) trade preference programme as “predictable and preventa  Instagram
articles.full_text:
Staff Reporter
US Ambassador to South Africa has described the country’s removal from the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) trade preference programme as “predictable and preventable”, saying the decision followed the South African government’s rejection of concerns raised by Washington.
In a statement, the ambassador said he remained hopeful the two countries could address broader bilateral concerns, but stressed that South Africa’s government needed to understand the seriousness of the situation.
He said he would continue pursuing a partnership in which both countries could succeed, and would do so as quickly as possible.
